Ledger, intents, attempts and authority events are append-only by design and must not be rewritten.
specAmbiguitiesResolved: One action digest per authority: allowedActionKinds = [subject kind], per-action limit = subject amount, base (aggregate) limit = approval maximum; intents bind exactly the per-action limit.

Plan-action approvals are recorded by M09 from the exact M08-prepared scope and bound to the request; paid contact approvals come from M02 recordApproval (M07); issuance names the subject and recomputes its digest.
Approvals are not CONSUMED at issuance, so M06/M08/M02 invalidation keeps blocking new reserves; in-flight effects reconcile regardless.

Transient linearization holds (authority SUSPENDED, session not CONFIRMED, insufficient available authority) leave the intent CREATED; permanent invalidity (revoked/expired authority or approval, digest/subject mismatch, stale asset/evidence/policy, provider revision not current, M06 gate, pre-egress UNSUPPORTED capability) makes it definite-no-effect FAILED.
A provider lookup 'not found' is authoritative no-effect only when the adapter guarantees fencing of that key (LOCAL_STAND_IN and RECORDED_CONTRACT do; Kite does not document it).
A claimed capture above the open reservation is never captured: UNKNOWN, capability UNSUPPORTED, manual review.

UNKNOWN -> REFUNDED/REVERSED is taken directly when the first authoritative observation already shows full returns (CAPTURE appended first in the same transaction); otherwise CONFIRMED -> REFUNDED/REVERSED.
Budget adjustment direction and amount are bound in the BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT approval's action_digest (budget-adjustment.v1) since approvals have no direction column.
A replayed execution reference performs nothing (nonce recorded per operation); callers mint a new reference to retry after a hold.
Broker outcome type is its own AdapterOutcome (digests) rather than ExternalOutcomeResultSchema (needs M05 blob ids).
securityReview: Authority forgery: Ed25519 scope signature verified by the broker (public keys only) at session activation and every linearization; DB insert guard binds the scope to its approval; scope columns immutable (UB001). Regression: copied signature over a widened purpose -> AUTHORITY_SIGNATURE_INVALID.

Digest substitution: subject facts reloaded and the action digest recomputed at issuance, intent creation and linearization; request fields must equal the signed scope; the authority must belong to the named approval (M07 contract).

Double spend: one RESERVE per intent, one attempt per intent, partial unique index across authorities, row-lock serialization; 6 concurrent executes -> 1 send; 6 concurrent reconciles -> 1 capture; no replacement attempt ever.

Refund-as-credit: availability = effective limit - open - gross captured; returns never raise it; re-credit only via a finance approver's signed BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT applied once; a PLAN_ACTION approval cannot be applied as a credit (UB097).

Race conditions: FIXED FOR UPDATE vs FK KEY SHARE deadlocks (FOR NO KEY UPDATE); linearization serializes with M08 invalidation via the planning advisory lock and with revocation via the authority row; policy/evidence races tested both sides.

Credential leakage: secret only on fd/0600 file, never env/argv; scrubbing logger; adapters hide credentials from toJSON/inspect (#private), map transport errors to reason codes; error bodies carry code/reasonCode/message only; probes found no secret in ps, logs or a full database dump.

SSRF: LOCAL_STAND_IN base URL must be loopback HTTPS, pinned certificate, agent:false, no redirects/proxies; Kite merchant endpoints must be https and allowlisted; no URL is ever taken from a request.
Replay: references expire (5 min) and are single-use per operation; FIXED a foreign-tenant reference now fails WRONG_TARGET before any write (previously an FK error / 500).
Cross-tenant budget: composite tenant FKs on every M09 table; foreign humans/services/references get RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE / EXECUTION_REFERENCE_INVALID.
FIXED production config refuses a send lease shorter than the adapter timeout + 1 s (a sweep could otherwise relabel a running send UNKNOWN).

COORDINATOR MEDIUM 1 FIXED (red fdf0b83, fix 9f7848a): same-key replay re-sent without revalidating authority; now refused unless every precondition holds (UNKNOWN, reserved, manual; REPLAY_AUTHORITY_NOT_CURRENT).

COORDINATOR MEDIUM 2 FIXED (red fdf0b83, fix ef580d1): `kpass session execute` could pay from kpass's current session or the allowance; execution now resolves the authority's own approval request id to its session via `kpass session status --request-id`, refuses (not sent) unless active, and passes `--session-id` (flag verified in passport-skills x402-execute/references/commands.md).

COORDINATOR MEDIUM 3 FIXED (red fdf0b83, fix 230d186): Kite session TTL was rounded up past authority expiry from the broker clock; remaining lifetime now comes from the PostgreSQL clock, < 60 s is refused pre-egress (AUTHORITY_LIFETIME_TOO_SHORT) and ttl_seconds never exceeds it.

COORDINATOR HIGH 1 FIXED (red 34e24c2, fix 114b320): the replay gate was a hand-copied subset of linearize (missed the M06 decision gate, stored digest, amount/bound and intent-authority binding); all preconditions now live in assertExecutionPreconditionsInTx, called by both linearize and replaySameKey (structural test t040-execution-paths).

COORDINATOR HIGH 2/3 FIXED (red 34e24c2, fix e6daf56, sweep edf7b22): a not-sent adapter refusal was treated as no-effect proof on replay/reconcile and after an observed handoff, releasing the reservation; applyOutcome now honours it only on a first EXECUTE still SEND_STARTED/AUTHORIZED, replaySameKey maps it to manual, the session path never fabricates REQUESTED/FAILED from it, and every producer was swept (kpass exit 8 marked notSent; stand-in/fake only authoritative).
unresolvedRisks: No real Kite, provider or payment path has run; Kite has no documented payment lookup by client key, so autonomous Kite execution is UNSUPPORTED until same-key replay is verified with a real account (ADR 0003 lists every unverified detail).

Isolation is same-uid local process isolation (F0 limits): a same-uid process can connect to the 0600 socket (signatures still required) and could read broker memory with a debugger; production network policy and workload identity are NOT_RUN.

The execution-reference HMAC key is shared by reference issuers (API/worker) and the broker; a compromised issuer can request execution of any CREATED intent of its tenant (still bounded by authority, approval and every revalidation).
issueBrokerWorkerContext is exported from @uptimebuyer/data (same strength as outbox/job worker contexts); any importer can mint a worker-scoped context.
The ledger trigger does not re-check adjustment direction (only the service layer compares the approval's budget-adjustment digest); a raw database writer with a DEBIT approval could insert a CREDIT.
provider_contact_attempts.commercial_intent_id has no FK to commercial_intents (M07 contract-fake tests insert fake ids).
Incident state transitions (AWAITING_APPROVAL -> EXECUTING, ESCALATED after possible egress) are not driven by M09; plan EXECUTING -> COMPLETED is not driven (M10).
No HTTP API server or scheduler exists: KiteBroker.sweep runs inside the broker process every --sweep-ms; expiry, session reconciliation and refund pickup depend on it running.
nextModuleInputs: M10 (orders/jobs): consume commercial_intent.state_changed.v1 (resultOrigin KITE_BROKER) and external_attempt.*.v1; a CONFIRMED intent is a payment observation only (external_receipts kinds PAYMENT_SETTLEMENT/PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE/REFUND/REVERSAL/NO_EFFECT_PROOF), never fulfillment; create purchase_orders/service_jobs from intent ids; drive plan EXECUTING -> COMPLETED.

M14 deploy: run apps/kite-broker as its own workload identity with `node --disable-sigusr1`, deliver the secret document by fd or 0600 file from the secret manager (databaseUrl, referenceKeyring, authorityPublicKeys, compatibilitySigning, adapter), place the socket in a 0700 directory reachable only by the API and outbox-dispatch identities, deny Kite/paid egress to every other workload, and keep sendLeaseMs >= adapter timeout + 1 s.
